fields.headline: Extends the Alameda County Probation mentoring agreement to September 2021; the $390,000 grant was already in the original
fields.summary: This first amendment to the district's memorandum of understanding with the Alameda County Probation Department extends the Cross-Age Mentoring Program, in which high school students mentor middle school students one-on-one, from September 2020 to September 30, 2021. It also adds language on ownership of the program curriculum. The $390,000 grant was already part of the original 2019 agreement, and the amendment adds no new money. It covers Oakland High, Westlake Middle and Roosevelt Middle schools.

21-0850.note: Corrected: the $390,000 grant was already part of the original 2019 agreement; this amendment extends the term and adds curriculum language but adds no new money.
